skill_name: Describe the life of a typical pre-school child in 200 words or less.
workflow: For a typical preschool child, life is an exciting, carefree and playful journey full of discovery and learning opportunities. Children at this age are inquisitive and eager to explore the world around them and are becoming increasingly independent. On any given day, a preschooler may go on an imaginative adventure into their favorite book or interactive game, or head off to the playground to enjoy some active playtime.
